| **Frequency of Use:** | \~1–3 times / quarter |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | • BR98, BR99, BR212: Future commitments interrupted by facility/court retirement must be moved to an equivalent court with customer consent or refunded 100%. • BR223 (Court Retirement Eligibility): A court unit can only stop accepting new bookings after all ongoing sessions and future commitments on that court have concluded or been handled per facility-fault policies. • BR235 (Court Facility Membership): Retains link to its parent branch. • BR246, BR247: Preserves full history and logs actor, timestamp, before/after state, and rationale. |  |  |
| **Other Information:** | For temporary repairs, managers use UC39 (Block Maintenance Slots); UC89 is used for long-term or permanent court retirement. |  |  |
| **Assumptions:** | Physical court signage is updated on-site to match the deactivated status. |  |  |

##### **b. Business Rules**

| ID | Business Rule | Business Rule Description |
| ----- | :---- | :---- |
| **▶ MODULE 1: COURT BOOKING SERVICES (MF1)** |  |  |
| **BR1** | **Minimum Session Duration** | A court booking session must have a minimum duration of 60 minutes. |
| **BR2** | **Published Slot Alignment** | Court booking times must strictly align with the discrete time slots published by the facility. |
| **BR3** | **Single Booking Horizon** | Single bookings can only be scheduled for future sessions starting no later than the end of the current date plus 14 calendar days, within opening hours (today counts as day 0). |
| **BR4** | **Booking Start Cutoff** | New court bookings can only be initiated prior to the scheduled start time of the session. |
| **BR5** | **Checkout Hold Duration** | The temporary checkout hold lock for a single booking is valid for exactly 420 seconds (7 minutes) from when the customer proceeds to payment. |
| **BR6** | **Court Occupancy Exclusivity** | Active court reservations or hold locks on the same court must never have overlapping time intervals. |
| **BR7** | **Unpaid Hold Expiry** | An unpaid slot hold is automatically treated as expired and invalid once the temporary hold period elapses. |
| **BR8** | **Released Slot Eligibility** | When a court hold ends, the slot is only reopened for public booking if no other active reservation hold or maintenance block exists. |
| **BR9** | **Online Prepayment Policy** | Online bookings must complete 100% of the due payment via VNPay before confirmation; VietQR cannot be used as an online fallback channel. |
| **BR10** | **Booking Confirmation Eligibility** | An online booking is officially confirmed only after its due payment obligation is recorded as successful. |
| **BR11** | **Booking Contact Record** | The check-in contact information for a booking is the contact information finalized at the time of reservation. |
| **BR12** | **Booking Contact Preservation** | Modifying member profile information must not alter the finalized check-in recipient details on existing bookings. |
| **BR13** | **Advance Service Classification** | Pre-declared service preferences are treated as preparation estimates, not actual delivered services. |
| **BR14** | **Advance Service Charge Exclusion** | Pre-declared service preferences must not be added to the online court fee payment obligation. |
| **BR15** | **Advance Service Stock Exclusion** | Pre-declared service preferences must not trigger inventory stock deduction. |
| **BR16** | **Recurring Member Eligibility** | Only registered Customer account holders are eligible to apply for recurring court booking contracts. |
| **BR17** | **Recurring Contract Duration** | A recurring booking contract must have a duration of 4 to 12 consecutive weeks. |
| **BR18** | **Weekly Session Frequency** | A recurring booking schedule template must contain between 1 and 7 court sessions per week. |
| **BR19** | **Recurring Schedule Pattern** | Recurring schedule sessions maintain a fixed day-of-week, time slot, and court across contract weeks, except for conflicting sessions handled individually at contract creation. |
| **BR20** | **Recurring Price Source** | Recurring contract pricing is derived from the recurring booking pricing policy published by the Court Owner. |
| **BR21** | **Recurring Installment Deadline** | Payment for each recurring billing installment must be paid prior to the start of that 4-week cycle. |
| **BR22** | **Review Eligibility** | Only a Customer who owns a completed court booking is permitted to submit a review for that booking. |
| **BR23** | **Booking Review Uniqueness** | Each completed booking can receive at most one review from the booking customer. |
| **BR24** | **Rating Score Range** | The review rating score must be an integer ranging from 1 to 5\. |
| **BR25** | **Maintenance Booking Exclusion** | New court booking rights cannot be granted for time slots overlapping with an active facility maintenance window. |
| **BR26** | **Price Scope Dimensions** | A court price scope dimension consists of branch facility, sport category, booking type, day type, and time slot. |
| **BR27** | **Peak Period Definition** | Peak hours are defined as \[17:00, 22:00) on all days; all other operating hours are off-peak, including weekends and holidays. |
| **BR28** | **Voucher Member Eligibility** | Only registered Customer account holders are permitted to apply promotional vouchers. |
| **BR29** | **Voucher Count Limit** | Each court booking order can only apply at most one promotional voucher. |
| **BR30** | **Percentage Voucher Reduction** | Percentage discount is calculated as min(HALF\_UP(Bv × p / 100), Cap, Bv), where 0 \< p ≤ 100 with at most two decimals, and Cap is a required positive integer in VND. |
| **BR31** | **Fixed Voucher Reduction** | Fixed voucher discount equals min(F, Bv), where F is a non-negative fixed discount amount and Bv is the eligible court fee. |
| **BR32** | **Nonnegative Discounted Amount** | The discounted court booking fee after applying a voucher must never be less than 0 VND. |
| **BR33** | **Voucher Validity Period** | A promotional voucher can only be applied within the active validity date window of its campaign. |
| **BR34** | **Voucher Budget Availability** | A voucher can only be applied if the remaining available budget of the campaign is sufficient to cover the discount amount. |
| **BR35** | **Voucher Usage Limit** | A voucher can only be applied if the total usage limit of the campaign has not been exceeded. |
| **BR36** | **Voucher Minimum Order** | The booking order value must meet the minimum order threshold required by the voucher campaign. |
| **BR37** | **Voucher Facility Eligibility** | The booking must take place at a branch facility permitted by the voucher campaign. |
| **BR38** | **Voucher Booking Eligibility** | The booking type (single or recurring) must match the allowed booking categories defined by the campaign. |
| **BR39** | **Voucher Consumption Event** | A voucher usage quota is only officially recorded as consumed once the booking payment transaction succeeds. |
| **BR40** | **Committed Price Preservation** | The committed price of a validly held or confirmed booking is not altered by subsequent changes to general pricing policies. |
| **BR41** | **Reschedule Voucher Exclusion** | The new rescheduled slot for a single booking cannot apply promotional vouchers. |
| **BR42** | **Cancelled Voucher Consumption** | A voucher applied to a cancelled booking is counted as consumed and is not restored to the customer. |
| **BR43** | **Recurring Advance Horizon** | The start date of a recurring contract must be between tomorrow and the same date of the current month plus three calendar months (using month-end if day exceeds). |
| **BR44** | **Conflicting Recurring Occurrence Omission** | When creating a recurring contract, the customer is permitted to omit individual sessions that conflict with pre-booked slots. |
| **BR45** | **Conflicting Recurring Occurrence Revision** | When creating a recurring contract, the customer is permitted to individually adjust date, time, or court for conflicting sessions. |
| **BR46** | **Overdue Installment Contact** | When a recurring contract installment is overdue, the Facility Manager must contact the Customer to remind them to settle payment. |
| **BR47** | **Minimum Overdue Retention** | Unpaid recurring session slots must be retained for at least one week from the start of that 4-week cycle before they can be released. |
| **BR48** | **Discretionary Overdue Release** | After the minimum retention period in BR162, the Facility Manager may flexibly release unpaid future sessions in overdue cycles; played or paid sessions cannot be released. |
| **BR49** | **Recurring Billing Period** | A standard recurring billing installment cycle consists of 4 weeks. |
| **BR50** | **Currency Rounding** | Each VND financial line item must be rounded HALF\_UP to integer currency; voucher/receipt totals equal the sum of rounded line items. |
| **BR51** | **Discount Allocation** | Discounts are allocated proportionally based on pre-discount session prices, using largest remainder method to match total discount, breaking ties by ascending session ID. |
| **BR52** | **Cancelled Campaign Budget** | Cancelling a confirmed booking does not restore the consumed voucher usage or discount budget back to the expired or active campaign. |
| **BR53** | **Replacement Voucher Expiry** | A replacement voucher issued due to facility fault is strictly for the affected customer, same branch and booking type, valid for 30 calendar days with no minimum order. |
| **BR54** | **Recurring Creation Exception Scope** | Individually adjusted conflicting sessions at contract creation must share the same facility, sport, and duration, falling within contract dates without consuming post-confirmation quotas. |
| **BR55** | **Omitted Occurrence Charge** | Sessions omitted during contract creation do not incur any payment obligation. |
| **BR56** | **Partial Final Installment** | A final contract cycle under 28 days only charges the discounted fee for the actual sessions held, without rounding up to a full 4-week cycle. |
| **BR57** | **Installment Start Time** | Recurring billing cycles start at 00:00 on the contract start date and every 28 calendar days thereafter, based on Vietnam standard time. |
| **BR58** | **Unpaid Occurrence Admission** | A recurring session that has not been fully paid cannot be checked in during the overdue waiting period. |
| **BR59** | **Partial Installment Allocation** | Partial installment payments are allocated in chronological order of sessions; a session is considered paid only when its full fee is covered. |
| **BR60** | **Late Payment Refund** | Successful payments received after the 420-second hold window has expired must be refunded 100% in full. |
| **BR61** | **Late Payment Review Deadline** | The Facility Manager must reconcile late payments within 24 hours and initiate refund processing within 48 hours from receipt verification. |
| **BR62** | **Boundary Price Segmentation** | Court fees spanning pricing boundaries are summed by discrete minute intervals according to the rate card and rounded per line, not charged at a single flat rate. |
| **BR63** | **Voucher Minimum Base** | Minimum order thresholds evaluate the pre-voucher court fee; recurring contracts evaluate only the first installment cycle. |
| **BR64** | **Recurring Voucher Scope** | A recurring contract may apply at most one voucher to its first billing cycle if permitted by campaign rules; subsequent cycles cannot apply vouchers. |
| **BR65** | **Voucher Temporary Reservation** | Voucher quota and discount budget are held temporarily alongside the 420-second court hold window for valid first-come checkout requests. |
| **BR66** | **Held Voucher Protection** | A validly held voucher discount amount is preserved until the hold expires even if the campaign is updated or paused; expired holds release the quota. |
| **BR67** | **Retired Court Price Commitments** | Retiring an hourly court price version does not alter pricing for confirmed bookings or active valid reservation holds. |
| **▶ MODULE 2: BOOKING LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT (MF2)** |  |  |
| **BR68** | **Recurring Absence Notice** | Notice of absence or adjustment for a recurring session must be submitted at least 24 hours prior to the session start time. |
| **BR69** | **Monthly Adjustment Allowance** | Each recurring contract is permitted a maximum of two successful session adjustments with original dates falling in the same calendar month, including direct rescheduling or make-up bookings. |
| **BR70** | **Approved Absence Release** | An approved recurring absence immediately terminates the reservation hold on that absent session. |
| **BR71** | **Recurring Monetary Refund Exclusion** | Reporting absence for a recurring session does not entitle the member to a monetary refund. |
| **BR72** | **Absence Benefit Entitlement** | Each valid recurring absence notice grants exactly one make-up session entitlement. |
| **BR73** | **MakeUp Entitlement Validity** | A make-up session must conclude no later than the end of the original session date plus 30 calendar days, even if that date is after contract termination. |
| **BR74** | **Absence Benefit Exclusivity** | An original session can only utilize one adjustment entitlement (direct reschedule or make-up); rescheduled sessions cannot generate a second adjustment entitlement. |
| **BR75** | **Early Cancellation Refund** | For h ≥ 24 hours, the refund amount for a customer-cancelled single booking equals 0.80 × B, where B is the net paid court fee per BR153. |
| **BR76** | **Standard Cancellation Refund** | For 12 ≤ h \< 24 hours, the refund amount for a customer-cancelled single booking equals 0.50 × B, where B is the net paid court fee per BR153. |
| **BR77** | **Late Cancellation Refund** | For 6 ≤ h \< 12 hours, the refund amount for a customer-cancelled single booking equals 0.30 × B, where B is the net paid court fee per BR153. |
| **BR78** | **Late Rescheduling Eligibility** | For 6 ≤ h \< 12 hours, a single booking may still be considered for rescheduling if other rescheduling criteria are met. |
| **BR79** | **Self-Service Rescheduling Cutoff** | For 0 ≤ h \< 2 hours, customers are not permitted to self-service reschedule a single booking. |
| **BR80** | **Imminent Cancellation Refund** | For h \< 2 hours, the refund amount for customer-initiated cancellation is 0 VND. |
| **BR81** | **Rescheduling Supplement** | The supplemental fee when rescheduling a single booking equals max(Gm − Gc, 0), where Gc is the old post-voucher booking fee and Gm is the new schedule fee without voucher. |
| **BR82** | **Lower Price Refund Exclusion** | A new schedule fee lower than the previous post-voucher booking price does not generate any refund credit for the customer. |
| **BR83** | **Automatic Cancellation Allowance** | A Customer is permitted a maximum of two automatic cancellation approvals per calendar month chain-wide; from the third request onward, Facility Manager approval is required. |
| **BR84** | **Guest Cancellation Review** | Cancellation requests from Guest users must be verified and approved by the Facility Manager. |
| **BR85** | **Pending Cancellation Occupancy** | A pending cancellation request does not terminate the reservation hold on the booked court. |
| **BR86** | **Permitted Refund Channels** | Refunds may be paid via the original VNPay gateway transaction if integrated, bank transfer from the facility, or cash; the original payment channel must be prioritized. |
| **BR87** | **Facility Refund Authority** | The Facility Manager is authorized to approve refunds when the cumulative successful refunds, pending refunds, and current request on the same booking do not exceed 1,000,000 VND. |
| **BR88** | **Owner Refund Escalation** | Refund amounts that cause the cumulative total on the same booking to exceed 1,000,000 VND must be escalated to the Court Owner for approval. |
| **BR89** | **Refund Completion Evidence** | A refund record can only be marked as completed when valid proof of payment matching the selected payout channel is attached. |
| **BR90** | **Chain Refund Audit Access** | The Court Owner has full audit access to view refund history across the entire facility chain. |
| **BR91** | **Facility Refund Audit Access** | Facility Managers are restricted to viewing refund records only within their assigned branch facility. |
| **BR92** | **Cumulative Refund Limit** | For any original receipt, the sum of successful refunds, approved pending refunds, and new refund requests must not exceed the original collected amount. |
| **BR93** | **Booking Ownership Access** | A Customer may only view and perform operations on bookings or recurring entitlements belonging to their own account. |
| **BR94** | **Rescheduling Facility Scope** | Customers may only self-reschedule a single booking to available courts within the same branch facility. |
| **BR95** | **Staff Facility Scope** | Front-desk Staff may only execute counter and operational tasks within their officially assigned branch facility. |
| **BR96** | **Active Shift Eligibility** | Staff are permitted to record counter transactions only while having an active, validly opened work shift. |
| **BR97** | **Expected Drawer Cash** | Expected drawer cash E \= O \+ C − Dreturn − Fcash \+ I − X, where I/X represent documented cash additions/drops; all amounts recorded at actual receipt/payout time. |
| **BR98** | **Equivalent Court Remedy** | Bookings interrupted by facility faults can only be moved to an equivalent court per D10.01 upon customer consent, at no extra charge. |
| **BR99** | **Maintenance Refund Amount** | Refunds due to facility faults equal 100% of the actual post-discount court fee allocated to the undelivered session duration. |
| **BR100** | **Manager Facility Scope** | A Facility Manager has exactly one active facility assignment at any given time; source warehouse read exceptions are strictly limited per D13.02. |
| **BR101** | **Owner Chain Scope** | The Court Owner possesses chain-wide administrative authority for granted operations, but cannot arbitrarily bypass operational counter staff workflows. |
| **BR102** | **Personal Bank Refund Exclusion** | Refund bank transfers must strictly originate from official branch or chain bank accounts registered by the Owner; personal accounts are prohibited. |
| **BR103** | **Cross-Channel Refund Approval** | Any change to the refund payout channel requires explicit approval from the Court Owner and agreement from the customer. |
| **BR104** | **Last Minute Cancellation Refund** | For 2 ≤ h \< 6 hours prior to session start, the refund amount for a customer-cancelled single booking is 0 VND. |
| **BR105** | **Single Booking Reschedule Limit** | Each single court booking is permitted to be rescheduled at most once, whether via self-service or staff-assisted support. |
| **BR106** | **Refund Base Amount** | The base amount B for customer cancellation refunds is the actual net court fee collected after all discounts for that booking. |
| **BR107** | **Cancellation Count Event** | Cancellations counted toward quota are approved booking cancellations, aggregated across the Customer's account chain-wide. |
| **BR108** | **Facility Cancellation Quota Exclusion** | Booking cancellations caused by facility faults are never deducted from the Customer's monthly cancellation allowance. |
| **BR109** | **Facility Replacement Voucher** | Upon facility cancellation, the Facility Manager issues a dedicated replacement voucher matching the actual discount value of the original cancelled portion per D01.06. |
| **BR110** | **Successful Recurring Adjustment Debit** | A recurring session adjustment allowance is only consumed and debited once the session reschedule transaction completes successfully. |
| **BR111** | **Assisted Rescheduling Request** | Customers who exceed self-service timeframes may submit a reschedule request to Staff or Manager; receipt of request does not imply approval. |
| **BR112** | **Single Session Reschedule Lead Time** | Customers may only self-reschedule a single booking if the request is submitted at least 2 hours before session start time. |
| **BR113** | **Reschedule Target Horizon** | The target rescheduled slot must be at the same facility, for the same sport, same duration, and start within a 14-calendar-day window from the request date. |
| **BR114** | **Prestart Cancellation Eligibility** | Customer cancellation requests are accepted prior to session start time even if the refund rate is 0%; after start time, only unused time surrender is handled. |
| **BR115** | **Zero Refund Cancellation Count** | An approved customer cancellation still counts toward the monthly cancellation quota even when the calculated refund amount is 0 VND. |
| **BR116** | **Makeup Cash Exclusion** | A make-up session entitlement from recurring absence cannot be converted to cash or credited toward subsequent billing cycles. |
| **BR117** | **Makeup Expiry Consequence** | Unused make-up session entitlements automatically expire after the 30-day deadline without granting any monetary refund. |
| **BR118** | **Makeup Facility Scope** | A make-up session must take place at the same facility and for the same sport as the original session, but may choose a different court and time slot. |
| **BR119** | **Makeup Additional Payment** | The supplemental fee when booking a make-up session equals max(new schedule standard price − original session post-discount fee, 0), preserving original duration. |
| **BR120** | **Makeup Cheaper Price** | Choosing a make-up court session with a lower rate than the original session does not entitle the customer to any refund difference. |
| **BR121** | **Contract Termination Authority** | The Facility Manager is authorized to review and approve recurring contract termination requested by a customer. |
| **BR122** | **Termination Played Liability** | Upon contract termination, full payment must be collected for all sessions that have already been played. |
| **BR123** | **Termination Paid Protection** | Prepaid sessions that have not yet occurred are retained for the customer even after the contract stops creating new recurring reservations. |
| **BR124** | **Termination Unpaid Release** | When termination is approved, all reserved unpaid future sessions are released, and future payment obligations for those sessions are cancelled. |
| **BR125** | **Termination Paid Refund Exclusion** | Customer contract termination does not create refunds for retained paid sessions; unallocated excess funds must be reconciled and refunded per D04. |
| **BR126** | **Refund Execution Authority** | The payout executor must hold channel authority per D04.03 and verify proper administrative approval before executing the disbursement. |
| **BR127** | **Manager Refund Verification** | Payment evidence for refunds directly executed by a Facility Manager must be audited and verified by the Court Owner. |
| **BR128** | **Pending Refund Reservation** | A pending refund transaction reserves available refund quota until its success or failure is formally confirmed. |
| **BR129** | **Cash Refund Drawer** | Cash refunds can only be paid out from an active open work shift drawer at the correct branch facility when sufficient cash is present. |
| **BR130** | **Overcollection Refund** | A negative balance N generates an overcollection refund of −N per D04, handled separately from equipment deposits and never converted to internal credit. |
| **▶ MODULE 3: FRONT-DESK OPERATIONS (MF3)** |  |  |
| **BR131** | **Paid Session Retention** | A customer who has paid in full retains the right to use the booked court for the entire reserved duration, even if arriving late. |
| **BR132** | **Post-Session NoShow Classification** | A booking past its scheduled end time without check-in is classified as NO\_SHOW; this classification cannot be used to retroactively resell session rights. |
| **BR133** | **Unused Time Resale Consent** | Remaining paid court time may only be resold if the rightful booking holder explicitly confirms surrender of that unused time. |
| **BR134** | **Voluntary Unused Time Refund** | A customer who voluntarily abandons paid court time is not entitled to any refund for the unused duration. |
| **BR135** | **Late Arrival Extension Exclusion** | Arriving late to a booked session does not create any entitlement to free court time extension. |
| **BR136** | **Session Service Eligibility** | Services attached to a session can only be marked as in-service after the court booking has checked in; standalone retail is exempt from this rule. |
| **BR137** | **Retail Stock Recognition** | Physical retail inventory is deducted when goods are physically handed to the customer, not deducted a second time upon payment. |
| **BR138** | **Sale-Only Consumables** | Shuttlecocks and table tennis balls are retail sales items and cannot be issued under rental agreements. |
| **BR139** | **Rental Equipment Eligibility** | Rackets and pickleball balls belong to the authorized equipment category permitted for rental. |
| **BR140** | **Rental Guarantee Requirement** | Equipment rental orders strictly require cash or bank transfer security deposit collected before handing over equipment. |
| **BR141** | **Equipment Damage Charge** | Minor equipment damage compensation equals documented repair costs but cannot exceed 30% of the replacement value V finalized at rental confirmation. |
| **BR142** | **Deposit Compensation Eligibility** | The actual security deposit collected is permitted to be offset against verified damage compensation obligations. |
| **BR143** | **WalkIn Booking Authority** | Front-desk Staff are authorized to create on-site walk-in bookings for available courts within their assigned facility branch. |
| **BR144** | **Actual Service Charge Basis** | Session service charges are determined based on the actual quantity of services delivered during the court session. |
| **BR145** | **Overtime Grace Amount** | Overtime minutes r from 0 to 5 minutes have a surcharge coefficient of 0; r is calculated per formula in D09.03. |
| **BR146** | **Short Overtime Charge** | Overtime minutes r from 6 to 15 minutes incur a surcharge coefficient of 0.25 of the hourly rate. |
| **BR147** | **Medium Overtime Charge** | Overtime minutes r from 16 to 30 minutes incur a surcharge coefficient of 0.50 of the hourly rate. |
| **BR148** | **Extended Overtime Charge** | Total overtime surcharge equals R × (floor(m / 60\) \+ f(m mod 60)), where f follows BR68–BR70, and f(r) \= 1.0 when 31 ≤ r ≤ 59\. |
| **BR149** | **Overtime Availability** | Customers cannot continue playing past scheduled time if it encroaches upon the next reservation, even within the 5-minute grace period. |
| **BR150** | **Settlement Obligation** | Net settlement obligation N equals court fee \+ retail \+ services \+ rental fee \+ extension \+ overtime \+ compensation minus allocated prepayments, excluding deposits. |
| **BR151** | **Deposit Application Amount** | Applied deposit A \= min(D, H, max(N, 0)), where H is verified unpaid damage compensation; deposit cannot be applied to other service fees. |
| **BR152** | **Remaining Collection Amount** | Remaining payment due from the customer at counter check-out equals max(N − A, 0). |
| **BR153** | **Deposit Return Amount** | Deposit to return to the customer at check-out equals D − A − K, where K is the portion withheld due to unresolved dispute per D08.04 (K \= 0 if no dispute). |
| **BR154** | **Counter Payment Channels** | Accepted counter payment channels consist of cash or dynamic VietQR bank transfer. |
| **BR155** | **Collection Completion Requirement** | An on-site counter order can only be completed after all outstanding amounts due have been fully paid. |
| **BR156** | **Deposit Return Completion** | Rental settlement is completed only when all rented items and disputes are resolved, and remaining deposit is returned with documented receipts. |
| **BR157** | **Counter Rescheduling Exception** | Only the Facility Manager is authorized to approve on-site reschedule exceptions before session start if the reschedule quota is unused and slot matches D01.02. |
| **BR158** | **Extension Charge Exclusivity** | Court duration covered by paid time extension cannot be concurrently billed as overtime surcharge. |
| **BR159** | **Closed Shift Correction** | Adjusting a transaction after shift closure must utilize an adjustment voucher linked directly to the original receipt. |
| **BR160** | **Paid Sale Correction Approval** | All financial adjustments to paid transactions must be approved by the Facility Manager, with no exemption threshold. |
| **BR161** | **Delivered Consumable Return** | Consumables physically delivered to customers cannot be automatically returned to saleable stock simply due to receipt modification. |
| **BR162** | **Receipt Content Immutability** | Financial details of an officially issued receipt cannot be modified directly; adjustments require separate linked records. |
| **BR163** | **Payment Channel Classification** | Payments are strictly categorized by payment channel (cash, VNPay, VietQR) during shift reconciliation. |
| **BR164** | **Assisted Change Price Protection** | Rescheduling exceptions cannot waive price increases or exceed the single reschedule limit allowed for single bookings. |
| **BR165** | **Walkin Court Prepayment** | Walk-in customers must pay 100% of the court rental fee in full before checking in and entering the court. |
| **BR166** | **Early Check-in Window** | Customers may check in up to 15 minutes before the session; early check-in does not grant permission to use the court before scheduled time. |
| **BR167** | **Early Court Purchase** | Playing before scheduled session time is permitted only by purchasing an early extension block of at least 30 minutes without conflicting with other bookings. |
| **BR168** | **Inventory Reservation** | Confirmed order line items that have not yet been delivered hold available inventory; draft or estimated items do not hold stock. |
| **BR169** | **Available Inventory** | Available inventory equals physical on-hand stock minus validly held reservations minus quarantined stock. |
| **BR170** | **Sale Return Eligibility** | Delivered retail goods can only be accepted for return within the same work shift if factory seals are intact and the Facility Manager approves. |
| **BR171** | **Return Inventory Recognition** | Returned goods increase available stock only after physical inspection confirms resaleable condition; defective items must be quarantined. |
| **BR172** | **Inventory Nonnegative Balance** | Delivering quantities exceeding available inventory is strictly prohibited, even under managerial override. |
| **BR173** | **Inventory Unit Conversion** | Each SKU has one base integer counting unit; packaging conversion ratios must be positive integers issued by the Court Owner before transacting. |
| **BR174** | **Rental Deposit Value** | Equipment rental deposit equals total item count multiplied by replacement value V issued by the Owner and finalized before delivery; no waivers in baseline. |
| **BR175** | **Rental Time Charge** | Rental fee per item equals hourly rate P multiplied by started rental hours (minimum 1 hour); P is an hourly VND rate issued by the Owner independently of V. |
| **BR176** | **Lost Equipment Compensation** | Lost or irreparably damaged rental equipment must be compensated at replacement value V finalized at rental time; normal wear and tear is not charged. |
| **BR177** | **Partial Rental Return** | Rental duration stops for each individual item when Staff confirms receipt, even if other items on the rental order remain active. |
| **BR178** | **Disputed Deposit Retention** | Unresolved damage disputes do not forfeit the deposit; only withhold K up to V of disputed items (within D − A), returning the rest when undisputed items close. |
| **BR179** | **Overtime Minute Measurement** | Overtime minutes m \= max(ceil((actual court release timestamp − valid end time after extension) / 60 seconds), 0), regardless of payment time. |
| **BR180** | **Overtime Hour Price** | Hourly overtime rate R is the published hourly price of the court at session end according to the booking's finalized price version, without voucher and fixed. |
| **BR181** | **Unprovided Service Liability** | Undelivered service obligations caused by facility fault are waived if uncollected, or refunded 100% of actual paid fees if collected; deposits reconciled separately. |
| **BR182** | **Inactive SKU Eligibility** | A retired SKU cannot be added to new retail sales or rental transactions from the effective time of retirement. |
| **BR183** | **Inactive SKU Existing Obligations** | Retired SKUs must still fulfill existing confirmed order lines, equipment returns, financial settlements, and warehouse adjustments. |
| **BR184** | **Transaction Price Preservation** | Retail unit price, unit, and conversion ratio locked at sale confirmation, along with P and V locked at rental confirmation, cannot be altered by later config edits. |
| **BR185** | **Inventory Pricing Eligibility** | A new sale or rental line item is valid only if the item has been declared at the booking's facility branch, is active, and has effective pricing; rentals require both P and V. Available stock or same-named items at other branches cannot satisfy this condition. |
| **▶ MODULE 4: SHIFT RECONCILIATION (MF4)** |  |  |
| **BR186** | **Shift Handover Requirement** | Staff must perform cash drawer counting, categorize payment channels, and generate a shift handover report (Z-Report) upon shift closing. |
| **BR187** | **Cash Denomination Total** | Actual cash drawer count must be recorded by discrete bill denominations, calculating total physical cash as the sum of all denomination amounts. |
| **BR188** | **Cash Discrepancy Amount** | Cash variance equals actual physical cash counted minus expected drawer cash; variance is classified as overage when positive and shortage when negative. |
| **BR189** | **Cash Discrepancy Explanation** | Any shift handover report with cash discrepancy (variance different from 0\) strictly requires an explanatory note from the shift staff. |
| **BR190** | **Staff Report Signoff** | Staff must submit and electronically sign the shift handover report upon completing cash counts and channel reconciliation. |
| **BR191** | **Manager Report Approval** | The Facility Manager must review, verify reconciliation figures, and formally sign off on the shift handover report. |
| **BR192** | **Approved Report Immutability** | A shift handover report that has been formally approved by the Facility Manager cannot be modified; any post-approval adjustments require linked correction slips. |
| **BR193** | **Staff Open Shift Limit** | A Staff member can only have at most one active open work shift at any given time within the facility chain. |
| **BR194** | **Counter Open Shift Limit** | A reception service counter can only host at most one active open work shift at any given time. |
| **BR195** | **Opening Cash Exception** | If physical opening drawer cash differs from the branch standard baseline, Staff must enter an exception reason, which requires Facility Manager verification. |
| **BR196** | **Next Shift Eligibility** | A new work shift at a counter can only be opened after the preceding shift at that counter has been closed, submitted, and reconciled. |
| **▶ MODULE 5: FACILITY OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT (MF5)** |  |  |
| **BR197** | **Inventory Entry Authority** | Facility Managers are authorized to record goods receipts from suppliers and perform routine stock adjustments within their assigned branch. |
| **BR198** | **Supplier Receipt Evidence** | Recording goods receipts from external suppliers must attach valid supplier delivery notes, invoices, or signed inspection receipts. |
| **BR199** | **Weekly Stocktake Deadline** | Physical inventory stocktakes must be performed periodically at least once per week, concluding before the weekly cutoff time. |
| **BR200** | **Stocktake Variance Target** | Physical inventory counts must be reconciled against system on-hand balances; discrepancies must be classified as shrinkage, damage, or counting errors. |
| **BR201** | **Maintenance Authority** | The Facility Manager within their managed branch or the Court Owner is authorized to place emergency or scheduled court maintenance holds. |
| **BR202** | **Stock Adjustment Evidence** | Manual inventory stock adjustments must specify adjustment reasons, physical evidence, and manager approval in audit logs. |
| **BR203** | **Password Minimum Length** | System account passwords must have a minimum length of 6 characters. |
| **BR204** | **Account Role Set** | Each user account is assigned internal permissions matching defined system roles: Customer, Staff, Facility Manager, and Court Owner. |
| **BR205** | **Staff Provisioning Authority** | The Facility Manager is authorized to create Staff user accounts for personnel assigned to work at their facility. |
| **BR206** | **Staff Scheduling Authority** | The Facility Manager is authorized to schedule, assign, and manage counter shifts for staff within their branch. |
| **BR207** | **Staff Deactivation Authority** | The Facility Manager is authorized to deactivate Staff accounts upon employee resignation or transfer. |
| **BR208** | **Account Email Uniqueness** | Each system user account must have a unique verified email address across the entire platform database. |
| **BR209** | **Account History Retention** | Deactivating or locking a user account preserves all historical transaction, audit, and operational logs without physical deletion. |
| **BR210** | **Immediate Revocation** | Deactivating a staff account immediately revokes all operational access tokens and terminates active counter sessions. |
| **BR211** | **Staff Schedule Separation** | A Staff member assigned to two consecutive shifts must have a scheduled rest interval of at least 30 minutes between shifts. |
| **BR212** | **Equivalent Court Definition** | An equivalent replacement court must belong to the same facility branch, same sport, same court surface quality, and meet or exceed the original booked specifications. |
| **BR213** | **Replacement Response Deadline** | Customers offered an alternative court due to facility maintenance or interruption have up to 30 minutes before session start to accept or choose a full refund. |
| **BR214** | **High Inventory Variance Approval** | Inventory count adjustments resulting in a variance ratio of 1% or higher must be approved by the Court Owner; under 1% requires Facility Manager approval. |
| **BR215** | **Inventory Variance Ratio** | Inventory variance ratio equals 100 × Σ(abs(q\_actual − q\_book) × cost\_price) / Σ(q\_book × cost\_price), using moving average cost per D11.02. |
| **BR216** | **Utilization Ratio** | Court utilization ratio equals total court minutes actually used divided by total available bookable minutes after excluding closures and maintenance. |
| **BR217** | **Management Revenue Recognition** | Management revenue is recognized at the time service is delivered or goods are handed over; deposits and unserved prepayments are tracked separately. |
| **BR218** | **Gross Profit Scope** | Gross operating profit equals net revenue minus direct cost of goods sold when sufficient data exists, and must not be mislabeled as net profit. |
| **BR219** | **External Stock Visibility** | A Facility Manager may view SKU names, units, and available stock quantities at other branches only to initiate transfer requests, without viewing cost or suppliers. |
| **BR220** | **Account Email Verification** | Customer, Staff, and Manager accounts may only log in and operate after email verification; Google Customers with verified email meet this requirement. |
| **BR221** | **Inventory Catalog Stock Separation** | Creating, modifying, or retiring master SKU catalog profiles must not directly alter physical or recorded stock quantities. |
| **BR222** | **Facility Retirement Eligibility** | A facility branch can only stop accepting new bookings after all active sessions and future service commitments have been completed or handled per facility-fault policies. |
| **BR223** | **Court Retirement Eligibility** | A court unit can only stop accepting new bookings after all ongoing sessions and future commitments on that court have concluded or been handled per facility-fault policies. |
| **BR224** | **Goods Receipt Recording Authority** | The Facility Manager is authorized to record physically received goods at their branch without requiring prior Owner sign-off on the receipt note. |
| **▶ MODULE 6: CHAIN ADMINISTRATION (MF6)** |  |  |
| **BR225** | **Transfer Request Content** | An inter-branch stock transfer request must clearly specify the sending branch warehouse, receiving warehouse, items, quantities, and transfer rationale. |
| **BR226** | **Transfer Approval Authority** | Only the Court Owner holds authority to approve or reject inventory transfer requests between facility branches. |
| **BR227** | **Transfer Rejection Reason** | Any decision to reject an inter-branch transfer request must include an explicit explanatory reason recorded in system logs. |
| **BR228** | **Transfer Dispatch Limit** | The quantity of goods physically dispatched for inter-branch transfer cannot exceed the quantity formally approved by the Court Owner. |
| **BR229** | **Transit Stock Classification** | Dispatched goods not yet accepted by the destination warehouse are classified as in-transit, and cannot be counted as available stock at either facility. |
| **BR230** | **Accepted Receipt Quantity** | The receiving facility branch may only increase local available inventory according to the actual accepted quantity verified upon arrival. |
| **BR231** | **Transfer Variance Closure** | A stock transfer with quantity discrepancies can only be officially closed after the Court Owner confirms the variance resolution plan. |
| **BR232** | **Pricing Policy Authority** | Only the Court Owner is authorized to issue, revise, or retire court rental pricing policies across the chain. |
| **BR233** | **Peak Price Floor** | Peak-hour court rental pricing must be greater than or equal to 1.20 times the off-peak rate for the same court and scope dimensions. |
| **BR234** | **Facility Closure Eligibility** | A branch facility with active unresolved future bookings cannot be deactivated to avoid breaching service commitments to customers. |
| **BR235** | **Court Facility Membership** | Each sports court belongs strictly to exactly one branch facility in the chain hierarchy. |
| **BR236** | **Court Sport Membership** | Each court is configured to serve exactly one designated sport category declared in master configuration. |
| **BR237** | **Manager Appointment Authority** | Only the Court Owner is authorized to appoint, reassign, or revoke Facility Manager administrative roles. |
| **BR238** | **Facility Principal Manager** | Each branch facility has at most one active primary Facility Manager; the Court Owner assumes temporary control if vacant. |
| **BR239** | **Inventory Catalog Authority** | Only the Court Owner is authorized to create, update, reactivate, or retire SKUs and configure selling prices, rental fees, and replacement values. |
| **BR240** | **Facility SKU Uniqueness** | An inventory item code must be unique within its declared facility branch, including retired codes; items at other facilities are not required to share a master profile. |
| **BR241** | **Transacted SKU Identity** | SKUs that have historical transactions cannot alter their item category (sale vs rental) or base unit; changes require creating a new SKU. |
| **BR242** | **Inventory Price Scope** | An inventory price version defines SKU, facility or chain scope, price type, unit, and validity interval \[start, end); omitting end means active until replaced. |
| **BR243** | **Inventory Price Amount** | Retail price, hourly rental rate per item P, and replacement value V must be positive integer VND amounts issued by the Court Owner. |
| **BR244** | **Inventory Price Period Uniqueness** | Pricing versions sharing the same SKU, facility, price type, and unit of measurement must never have overlapping validity periods. |
| **BR245** | **Inventory Price Nonretroactivity** | The effective start or end date of a newly published inventory price version cannot be earlier than the timestamp the Owner confirmed the change. |
| **BR246** | **Master Record History Retention** | Branch facilities, courts, SKUs, Managers, vouchers, and price versions cannot be physically deleted; full history is preserved upon retirement or edit. |
| **BR247** | **Catalog Audit Accountability** | Every catalog or pricing modification executed by the Court Owner must record actor, timestamp, before/after values, and business rationale in admin logs. |
| **BR248** | **Manager Profile Authority Boundary** | Updating a Manager profile is strictly restricted to changing display name and business contact; login credentials and appointment privileges cannot be altered. |
| **▶ MODULE 7: IDENTITY MANAGEMENT (MF7)** |  |  |
| **BR249** | **Member Phone Uniqueness** | A Customer registration phone number must be unique across all system user accounts according to source registration rules. |
| **BR250** | **Account Login Eligibility** | Locked user accounts or revoked permission sets cannot open active user sessions possessing revoked privileges. |
| **BR251** | **Profile Email Immutability** | A Customer is not permitted to self-modify their account email address through the self-service profile update feature. |
| **BR252** | **Password Change Distinction** | A newly chosen password during a password change operation must be strictly different from the current existing password. |
| **BR253** | **Google Link Eligibility** | Google OAuth may only be linked to an existing Customer account after explicit re-authentication if emails match; automatic binding is prohibited. |
| **BR254** | **Inactive Recovery Restriction** | Deactivated accounts cannot self-service reset passwords; changing a password does not automatically restore previously revoked system privileges. |
| **BR255** | **Customer Phone Change** | A Customer may update to a standardized phone number not used by another account after re-authentication and email confirmation; lost email cases require Owner approval. |

# **III. Analysis models.**

## ***III.1. High-level class diagram (structural models)***

Section III.1 defines the High-Level Class Diagram (Domain Model) representing the foundational structural concepts, major domain entities, and core associations governing the CourtChain multi-branch sport facility management platform. This domain model is derived directly from the business rules, functional use cases, entity relationships, and operational workflows defined throughout Section II.

![][image103]

[*Figure III.1. High-Level Class Diagram for CourtChain Domain Model*](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1X_6XpwJzLa9GG6JrQX017o8ntb5kp-e2)

| ID | Entity | Description | Relationships | Multiplicity (Two-Way Cardinality & Logic) |
| :---: | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | Account | A system user with one role (Customer, Staff, Facility Manager, Admin), contact details, and account status. | May have one workplace Facility and place many Bookings. Can work many Shifts. | **• Account — Facility: Account \[0..\*\] ── \[0..1\] Facility** \- Forward: An Account has 0..1 workplace Facility (Staff and Facility Managers belong to exactly 1 facility; Customers and Super Admins have no workplace facility: 0). \- Reverse: A Facility has 0..\* Accounts assigned to it (employing multiple staff members and branch managers). **• Account — Booking: Account \[0..1\] ── \[0..\*\] Booking** \- Forward: An Account may place 0..\* Bookings over time. \- Reverse: A Booking is associated with 0..1 Account (member bookings link to 1 account; walk-in counter bookings require no account: 0). **• Account — Shift: Account \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] Shift** \- Forward: An Account (staff) works 0..\* Shifts over time. \- Reverse: A Shift is operated and accounted for by exactly 1 staff Account. |
| 2 | Facility | A sports venue with its own physical address, phone, opening/closing hours, and operational status. | Has many Courts, CourtPrices, Products and Counters. May be a workplace or a stock transfer destination. | *(Relationships with Account are defined under \[1\] Account)* **• Facility — Court: Facility \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] Court** \- Forward: A Facility contains 0..\* Courts (a newly registered facility may initially have 0 courts before configuration). \- Reverse: A Court belongs to exactly 1 physical Facility. **• Facility — CourtPrice: Facility \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] CourtPrice** \- Forward: A Facility defines 0..\* CourtPrices (pricing rules by sport, day of week, and time slot). \- Reverse: A CourtPrice rule belongs to and is defined by exactly 1 Facility. **• Facility — Voucher: Facility \[1..\*\] ── \[0..\*\] Voucher** \- Forward: A Facility can participate in 0..\* promotional Vouchers. \- Reverse: A Voucher is applicable at 1..\* Facilities (valid at a single branch or across multiple branches). **• Facility — Product: Facility \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] Product** \- Forward: A Facility declares and inventories 0..\* Products (retail goods, rental equipment). \- Reverse: A Product (branch inventory item record) belongs to exactly 1 Facility. **• Facility — StockDocument: Facility \[0..1\] ── \[0..\*\] StockDocument** \- Forward: A Facility can be the destination branch of 0..\* inter-branch transfer StockDocuments. \- Reverse: A StockDocument has 0..1 destination Facility (only transfer documents specify a destination facility; supplier receipts or internal audits have none: 0). **• Facility — Counter: Facility \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] Counter** \- Forward: A Facility operates 0..\* physical service/cashier Counters. \- Reverse: A Counter belongs to exactly 1 Facility. |
| 3 | Court | An individual playing court for a specific sport (badminton, pickleball) with surface quality and operational status. | Belongs to one Facility. Used by many BookingSessions and WeeklySchedules. | *(Relationships with Facility are defined under \[2\] Facility)* **• Court — CourtMaintenance: Court \[1..\*\] ── \[0..\*\] CourtMaintenance** \- Forward: A Court can undergo 0..\* maintenance periods over time. \- Reverse: A CourtMaintenance event blocks 1..\* Courts (can block a single court or an entire cluster of courts simultaneously). **• Court — BookingSession: Court \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] BookingSession** \- Forward: A Court is utilized in 0..\* BookingSessions across scheduled time slots. \- Reverse: A BookingSession takes place on exactly 1 reserved Court. **• Court — WeeklySchedule: Court \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] WeeklySchedule** \- Forward: A Court can be selected in 0..\* WeeklySchedules of recurring contracts. \- Reverse: A WeeklySchedule reserves exactly 1 dedicated Court. **• Court — BookingChange (Original Court): Court \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] BookingChange** \- Forward: A Court serves as the original court for 0..\* change requests. \- Reverse: A BookingChange references exactly 1 original Court. **• Court — BookingChange (New Court): Court \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] BookingChange** \- Forward: A Court serves as the target/new court for 0..\* change requests. \- Reverse: A BookingChange assigns play to exactly 1 new Court (may be the same court if only time changed). |
| 4 | CourtPrice | An hourly rate based on sport, booking type, day of the week, and active time window. | Belongs to one Facility. Applies to matching courts and times; no direct Court link is drawn. | *(All relationships have been fully defined in prior entities: \[2\] Facility \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] CourtPrice. No direct outgoing associations to subsequent entities)* |
| 5 | CourtMaintenance | A scheduled period when courts are blocked from public reservation for maintenance or technical repair. | Blocks one or more Courts. Each Court can have many maintenance periods. | *(All relationships have been fully defined in prior entities: \[3\] Court \[1..\*\] ── \[0..\*\] CourtMaintenance. No outgoing associations to subsequent entities)* |
| 6 | Booking | A customer order for a one-time visit or a recurring schedule, storing contact details and order status. | Has one or more BookingSessions. May link to one Account, one RecurringBooking and one Voucher. | *(Relationships with Account are defined under \[1\] Account)* **• Booking — BookingSession: Booking \[1\] ── \[1..\*\] BookingSession** \- Forward: A Booking contains 1..\* BookingSessions (single booking has at least 1 session; recurring booking contains multiple sessions across weeks/months). \- Reverse: A BookingSession belongs to exactly 1 parent Booking. **• Booking — RecurringBooking: Booking \[1\] ── \[0..1\] RecurringBooking** \- Forward: A Booking is associated with 0..1 RecurringBooking contract (fixed schedule bookings have 1 contract; single one-off bookings have none: 0). \- Reverse: A RecurringBooking contract governs exactly 1 parent Booking. **• Booking — Voucher: Booking \[0..\*\] ── \[0..1\] Voucher** \- Forward: A Booking applies at most 0..1 Voucher (a booking can use at most one promotional voucher; none if unapplied: 0). \- Reverse: A Voucher can be applied across 0..\* Bookings (up to its allocated budget and usage limit). **• Booking — Invoice: Booking \[0..1\] ── \[0..\*\] Invoice** \- Forward: A Booking can be billed across 0..\* Invoices (initial invoice, recurring cycle invoices, adjustment invoices). \- Reverse: An Invoice bills 0..1 Booking (court fee invoice links to 1 booking; counter retail invoices link to a ServiceOrder: 0). **• Booking — Refund: Booking \[0..1\] ── \[0..\*\] Refund** \- Forward: A Booking may have 0..\* Refunds within its financial scope (due to cancellations or court disruption). \- Reverse: A Refund has 0..1 Booking as its scope (court refund links to 1 booking; counter retail refund links to a ServiceOrder: 0). |
| 7 | BookingSession | A dated playing period that reserves one court, tracks attendance, and records check-in/actual release times. | Belongs to one Booking and one Court. Can have many changes, absence requests and service orders, plus one optional Review. | *(Relationships with Court under \[3\], with Booking under \[6\])* **• BookingSession — BookingChange: BookingSession \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] BookingChange** \- Forward: A BookingSession can undergo 0..\* change requests (court/time rescheduling). \- Reverse: A BookingChange applies to exactly 1 original BookingSession. **• BookingSession — MakeUpRequest (Absence Source): BookingSession \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] MakeUpRequest** \- Forward: A BookingSession can serve as the missed/absence source of 0..\* MakeUpRequests. \- Reverse: A MakeUpRequest originates from exactly 1 missed BookingSession. **• BookingSession — MakeUpRequest (Redemption Session): BookingSession \[0..1\] ── \[0..1\] MakeUpRequest** \- Forward: A BookingSession may serve as the redemption/replacement session for 0..1 MakeUpRequest (standard sessions redeem none: 0). \- Reverse: An approved MakeUpRequest is redeemed by at most 0..1 replacement BookingSession. **• BookingSession — Review: BookingSession \[1\] ── \[0..1\] Review** \- Forward: A BookingSession receives at most 0..1 customer Review. \- Reverse: A Review evaluates exactly 1 completed BookingSession. **• BookingSession — Voucher (Compensation): BookingSession \[0..1\] ── \[0..\*\] Voucher** \- Forward: A BookingSession disrupted by facility faults can be compensated by 0..\* Vouchers. \- Reverse: A compensation Voucher references 0..1 source disrupted BookingSession (standard marketing vouchers reference none: 0). **• BookingSession — InvoiceDetail: BookingSession \[0..1\] ── \[0..\*\] InvoiceDetail** \- Forward: A BookingSession may be charged on 0..\* InvoiceDetails (base court fee line, reschedule surcharge line). \- Reverse: An InvoiceDetail charges for 0..1 BookingSession (charges for retail services reference none: 0). **• BookingSession — CancellationDetail: BookingSession \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] CancellationDetail** \- Forward: A BookingSession can be targeted by 0..\* CancellationDetails. \- Reverse: A CancellationDetail specifies cancellation terms for exactly 1 BookingSession. **• BookingSession — ServiceOrder: BookingSession \[0..1\] ── \[0..\*\] ServiceOrder** \- Forward: A BookingSession can be served by 0..\* counter ServiceOrders (court-side drinks, rental deliveries). \- Reverse: A ServiceOrder links to 0..1 active BookingSession (walk-in counter purchases link to none: 0). **• BookingSession — ServiceRequest: BookingSession \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] ServiceRequest** \- Forward: A BookingSession can pre-declare 0..\* ServiceRequests (equipment/drink preparation estimates). \- Reverse: A ServiceRequest belongs to exactly 1 BookingSession. |
| 8 | RecurringBooking | The agreement for regular play between a start and end date, defining contract validity and signing status. | Belongs to one Booking and has one or more WeeklySchedules. Actual dated sessions belong to the Booking. | *(Relationships with Booking are defined under \[6\] Booking)* **• RecurringBooking — WeeklySchedule: RecurringBooking \[1\] ── \[1..\*\] WeeklySchedule** \- Forward: A RecurringBooking defines 1..\* WeeklySchedules (e.g., every Monday and Wednesday). \- Reverse: A WeeklySchedule belongs to exactly 1 RecurringBooking contract. |
| 9 | WeeklySchedule | A weekly pattern specifying the playing day, start time, and duration for generating dated sessions. | Belongs to one RecurringBooking and selects one Court. Provides the pattern for generating BookingSessions. | *(All relationships have been fully defined in prior entities: \[3\] Court and \[8\] RecurringBooking. No outgoing associations to subsequent entities)* |
| 10 | BookingChange | A requested change with a known new time or court, tracking additional rescheduling fees and approval. | Belongs to one BookingSession. Links to one original Court and one new Court, which may be the same. | *(All relationships have been fully defined in prior entities: \[3\] Court (original & new) and \[7\] BookingSession. No outgoing associations to subsequent entities)* |
| 11 | MakeUpRequest | An absence request that grants an entitlement to a later replacement session upon manager approval. | Has one original BookingSession and at most one replacement BookingSession. A replacement session redeems at most one request. | *(All relationships have been fully defined in prior entities: \[7\] BookingSession (absence source and redemption session). No outgoing associations to subsequent entities)* |
| 12 | Review | A customer star rating and feedback comment submitted after completing a playing session. | Belongs to one BookingSession. Each session has at most one Review. | *(All relationships have been fully defined in prior entities: \[7\] BookingSession \[1\] ── \[0..1\] Review. No outgoing associations to subsequent entities)* |
| 13 | Voucher | A discount offer with eligibility criteria, minimum spend, validity window, and usage limits. | Applies at one or more Facilities and may serve many Bookings. A compensation voucher may reference one source BookingSession. | *(All relationships have been fully defined in prior entities: \[2\] Facility, \[6\] Booking, and \[7\] BookingSession. No outgoing associations to subsequent entities)* |
| 14 | Invoice | A financial bill or adjustment invoice recording payment obligations, due dates, and approval status. | May reference one Booking or ServiceOrder. Has one or more InvoiceDetails. An adjustment may reference one original Invoice, Payment or Shift. | *(Relationships with Booking are defined under \[6\] Booking)* **• Invoice — ServiceOrder: Invoice \[0..\*\] ── \[0..1\] ServiceOrder** \- Forward: An Invoice bills 0..1 ServiceOrder (court booking invoices reference none: 0). \- Reverse: A ServiceOrder can be billed by 0..\* Invoices (initial invoice, adjustments). **• Invoice — InvoiceDetail: Invoice \[1\] ── \[1..\*\] InvoiceDetail** \- Forward: An Invoice must contain 1..\* charge lines (InvoiceDetails). \- Reverse: An InvoiceDetail belongs to exactly 1 Invoice. **• Invoice — Invoice (Adjustment Self-Reference): Invoice \[0..1\] ── \[0..\*\] Invoice** \- Forward: An original Invoice can have 0..\* subsequent adjustment Invoices. \- Reverse: An adjustment Invoice references 0..1 original Invoice (original baseline invoices reference none: 0). **• Invoice — Payment (Receipt Correction): Invoice \[0..\*\] ── \[0..1\] Payment** \- Forward: An Invoice can correct the receipt details of 0..1 Payment. \- Reverse: A Payment may have its receipt corrected by 0..\* Invoices. **• Invoice — Shift: Invoice \[0..\*\] ── \[0..1\] Shift** \- Forward: An Invoice may be issued or adjusted within 0..1 counter Shift (automated online invoices link to none: 0). \- Reverse: A counter Shift can issue or adjust 0..\* Invoices. |
| 15 | InvoiceDetail | One line charge on a bill, specifying charge type, quantity, unit price, discount, and settled amount. | Belongs to one Invoice. May reference one BookingSession or ServiceOrderDetail. Can receive many PaymentDetails. | *(Relationships with BookingSession under \[7\], with Invoice under \[14\])* **• InvoiceDetail — ServiceOrderDetail: InvoiceDetail \[0..\*\] ── \[0..1\] ServiceOrderDetail** \- Forward: An InvoiceDetail charges for 0..1 ServiceOrderDetail (court fee lines reference none: 0). \- Reverse: A ServiceOrderDetail may be billed across 0..\* InvoiceDetails (base charge, adjustment discount). **• InvoiceDetail — PaymentDetail: InvoiceDetail \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] PaymentDetail** \- Forward: An InvoiceDetail receives payment settlements through 0..\* PaymentDetails. \- Reverse: A PaymentDetail allocates funds to exactly 1 line item (InvoiceDetail). |
| 16 | Payment | A monetary payment transaction capturing reference code, amount, channel, timestamp, and receipt number. | Has one or more PaymentDetails and an optional recording Shift. Can have many Refunds and receipt-correction Invoices. | *(Relationships with Invoice are defined under \[14\] Invoice)* **• Payment — PaymentDetail: Payment \[1\] ── \[1..\*\] PaymentDetail** \- Forward: A Payment must allocate its full amount through 1..\* PaymentDetails. \- Reverse: A PaymentDetail belongs to exactly 1 Payment transaction. **• Payment — Refund: Payment \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] Refund** \- Forward: A Payment is the financial source of 0..\* Refunds (partial or full refunds up to the payment amount). \- Reverse: A Refund must trace its financial source back to exactly 1 original Payment. **• Payment — Shift: Payment \[0..\*\] ── \[0..1\] Shift** \- Forward: A Payment is recorded within 0..1 Shift (in-person counter payments link to 1 shift; online VNPay payments link to none: 0). \- Reverse: A Shift records the collection of 0..\* in-person Payments. **• Payment — CashTransaction: Payment \[0..1\] ── \[0..1\] CashTransaction** \- Forward: A Payment causes 0..1 cash drawer entry (CashTransaction) if paid in cash; card or online channels cause none: 0\. \- Reverse: A CashTransaction entry may originate from 0..1 Payment (drawer float or deposit transactions link to none: 0). |
| 17 | PaymentDetail | The fraction of a payment transaction applied to settle one specific invoice line item. | Links one Payment to one InvoiceDetail. A payment can cover several lines; a line can receive several payments. | *(All relationships have been fully defined in prior entities: \[15\] InvoiceDetail and \[16\] Payment. No outgoing associations to subsequent entities)* |
| 18 | Cancellation | A customer request to cancel one or more playing sessions, recording cancellation reasons and review status. | Has one or more CancellationDetails. May support many Refunds. | **• Cancellation — CancellationDetail: Cancellation \[1\] ── \[1..\*\] CancellationDetail** \- Forward: A Cancellation request contains 1..\* CancellationDetails (one per cancelled session). \- Reverse: A CancellationDetail belongs to exactly 1 master Cancellation request. **• Cancellation — Refund: Cancellation \[0..1\] ── \[0..\*\] Refund** \- Forward: A Cancellation request grounds 0..\* approved Refunds. \- Reverse: A Refund may be grounded on 0..1 Cancellation (refunds due to facility faults ground on none: 0). |
| 19 | CancellationDetail | The cancellation assessment and refund rate calculation for an individual session based on advance notice hours. | Belongs to one Cancellation and references one BookingSession. A session may have many cancellation request records. | *(All relationships have been fully defined in prior entities: \[7\] BookingSession and \[18\] Cancellation. No outgoing associations to subsequent entities)* |
| 20 | Refund | A formal refund case approving the refund amount and documenting business justification. | References one source Payment. May link to one Cancellation and a Booking or ServiceOrder. Can have many RefundPayment attempts. | *(Relationships with Booking under \[6\], Payment under \[16\], Cancellation under \[18\])* **• Refund — ServiceOrder: Refund \[0..\*\] ── \[0..1\] ServiceOrder** \- Forward: A Refund applies to the scope of 0..1 ServiceOrder (court booking refunds link to none: 0). \- Reverse: A ServiceOrder can have 0..\* Refunds within its scope. **• Refund — RefundPayment: Refund \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] RefundPayment** \- Forward: An approved Refund generates 0..\* RefundPayment payout attempts (retrying if an electronic payout fails). \- Reverse: A RefundPayment belongs to exactly 1 approved Refund record. |
| 21 | RefundPayment | A disbursement transaction attempting to send approved refund money back to the customer. | Belongs to one Refund. May produce one CashTransaction when paid in cash. | *(Relationships with Refund are defined under \[20\] Refund)* **• RefundPayment — CashTransaction: RefundPayment \[0..1\] ── \[0..1\] CashTransaction** \- Forward: A RefundPayment causes 0..1 cash drawer exit (CashTransaction) if paid in cash at the counter; bank transfers cause none: 0\. \- Reverse: A CashTransaction exit originates from 0..1 RefundPayment. |
| 22 | ServiceOrder | An order for retail consumables, equipment rentals, or counter services created during a shift. | Opened in one Shift, with one or more ServiceOrderDetails. May link to one BookingSession and have many Invoices. | *(Relationships with BookingSession under \[7\], Invoice under \[14\], Refund under \[20\])* **• ServiceOrder — ServiceOrderDetail: ServiceOrder \[1\] ── \[1..\*\] ServiceOrderDetail** \- Forward: A ServiceOrder contains 1..\* itemized lines (ServiceOrderDetails). \- Reverse: A ServiceOrderDetail belongs to exactly 1 parent ServiceOrder. **• ServiceOrder — Shift: ServiceOrder \[0..\*\] ── \[1\] Shift** \- Forward: A ServiceOrder is opened and fulfilled within exactly 1 staff Shift. \- Reverse: A staff Shift opens and fulfills 0..\* counter ServiceOrders. |
| 23 | ServiceOrderDetail | One product or service line item, tracking units, rental return condition, and damage compensation. | Belongs to one ServiceOrder and references one Product. May belong to one Rental and appear on many InvoiceDetails. | *(Relationships with InvoiceDetail under \[15\], ServiceOrder under \[22\])* **• ServiceOrderDetail — Product: ServiceOrderDetail \[0..\*\] ── \[1\] Product** \- Forward: A ServiceOrderDetail supplies exactly 1 specific Product. \- Reverse: A Product can be supplied on 0..\* ServiceOrderDetails. **• ServiceOrderDetail — Rental: ServiceOrderDetail \[1..\*\] ── \[0..1\] Rental** \- Forward: A ServiceOrderDetail for equipment rental belongs to 0..1 Rental agreement (retail sale items belong to none: 0). \- Reverse: A Rental agreement groups 1..\* rented ServiceOrderDetails. **• ServiceOrderDetail — DepositTransaction: ServiceOrderDetail \[0..1\] ── \[0..\*\] DepositTransaction** \- Forward: A damaged or lost ServiceOrderDetail justifies 0..\* deposit forfeiture/deduction transactions. \- Reverse: A DepositTransaction references 0..1 violating ServiceOrderDetail (standard deposit collection or return links to none: 0). |
| 24 | ServiceRequest | An advance estimation request declaring the quantity of products or gear needed before playing. | Links one BookingSession to one Product. This is a request, not a billed order line. | *(Relationships with BookingSession are defined under \[7\] BookingSession)* **• ServiceRequest — Product: ServiceRequest \[0..\*\] ── \[1\] Product** \- Forward: A ServiceRequest specifies the advance preparation of exactly 1 Product. \- Reverse: A Product can be requested in 0..\* ServiceRequests. |
| 25 | Rental | A rental agreement grouping borrowed gear, required deposit, collected deposit, and withheld damage balance. | Groups one or more ServiceOrderDetails and has many DepositTransactions. Its ServiceOrder is reached through those details. | *(Relationships with ServiceOrderDetail are defined under \[23\] ServiceOrderDetail)* **• Rental — DepositTransaction: Rental \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] DepositTransaction** \- Forward: A Rental agreement records 0..\* DepositTransactions (deposit collection, return, forfeiture deduction). \- Reverse: A DepositTransaction belongs to exactly 1 Rental agreement. |
| 26 | DepositTransaction | A deposit movement recording collection, return, or forfeiture against damages. | Belongs to one Rental. May reference one ServiceOrderDetail to explain its use and one CashTransaction for a cash movement. | *(Relationships with ServiceOrderDetail under \[23\], Rental under \[25\])* **• DepositTransaction — CashTransaction: DepositTransaction \[0..1\] ── \[0..1\] CashTransaction** \- Forward: A DepositTransaction causes 0..1 cash flow entry in the drawer if processed in cash; electronic transfers cause none: 0\. \- Reverse: A CashTransaction reflects the cash flow of 0..1 DepositTransaction. |
| 27 | Product | An inventory item stocked at a specific facility, tracking on-hand, reserved, and quarantined quantities and unit cost. | Belongs to one Facility. Used in service and stock lines. Can have many ProductPrices; a shared price can cover several Products. | *(Relationships with Facility under \[2\], ServiceOrderDetail under \[23\], ServiceRequest under \[24\])* **• Product — ProductPrice: Product \[1..\*\] ── \[0..\*\] ProductPrice** \- Forward: A Product can have 0..\* ProductPrice rules over time. \- Reverse: A ProductPrice rule applies to and prices 1..\* Products across branches. **• Product — StockDetail (Source Item): Product \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] StockDetail** \- Forward: A Product acts as the source item on 0..\* StockDetails. \- Reverse: A StockDetail must designate exactly 1 source Product. **• Product — StockDetail (Destination Item): Product \[0..1\] ── \[0..\*\] StockDetail** \- Forward: A Product acts as the receiving destination item on 0..\* transfer StockDetails. \- Reverse: A StockDetail specifies 0..1 destination Product (only in inter-branch transfers; supplier receipts or audits specify none: 0). |
| 28 | ProductPrice | A selling or rental price rule for a catalog item during a defined validity period. | Prices one or more Products, allowing the same price to apply across facilities. | *(All relationships have been fully defined in prior entities: \[27\] Product \[1..\*\] ── \[0..\*\] ProductPrice. No outgoing associations to subsequent entities)* |
| 29 | StockDocument | A warehouse record for goods receipt from suppliers, inter-branch transfer, physical count audit, or adjustment. | Has one or more StockDetails. May reference one destination Facility and one earlier StockDocument as its basis. | *(Relationships with destination Facility are defined under \[2\] Facility)* **• StockDocument — StockDetail: StockDocument \[1\] ── \[1..\*\] StockDetail** \- Forward: A StockDocument contains 1..\* line items (StockDetails). \- Reverse: A StockDetail belongs to exactly 1 StockDocument. **• StockDocument — StockDocument (Basis Reference): StockDocument \[0..1\] ── \[0..\*\] StockDocument** \- Forward: An earlier StockDocument can serve as the legal basis for 0..\* subsequent StockDocuments (e.g., dispatch note bases receiving note). \- Reverse: A StockDocument references 0..1 earlier basis StockDocument (standalone initial receipts reference none: 0). |
| 30 | StockDetail | One line item on a stock document, capturing requested, approved, sent, received, or counted quantities and unit cost. | Belongs to one StockDocument. References one source Product and optionally one destination Product for a transfer. | *(All relationships have been fully defined in prior entities: \[27\] Product (source & destination) and \[29\] StockDocument. No outgoing associations to subsequent entities)* |
| 31 | Counter | A physical service or cashier desk within a sports venue where staff conduct shifts and process payments. | Belongs to one Facility and hosts many Shifts. | *(Relationships with Facility are defined under \[2\] Facility)* **• Counter — Shift: Counter \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] Shift** \- Forward: A Counter hosts 0..\* work Shifts over time. \- Reverse: A work Shift is operated at exactly 1 physical Counter. |
| 32 | Shift | An employee work shift capturing opening cash float, closing cash count, variance explanation, and approval. | Links one Account and one Counter. Has many service orders, cash counts and cash transactions; selects at most one closing CashCount. | *(Relationships with Account under \[1\], Counter under \[31\], ServiceOrder under \[22\], Invoice under \[14\], Payment under \[16\])* **• Shift — CashCount (Count Records): Shift \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] CashCount** \- Forward: A Shift conducts 0..\* CashCounts (opening float, spot audit, closing count). \- Reverse: A CashCount belongs to exactly 1 work Shift. **• Shift — CashCount (Closing Count Selection): Shift \[0..1\] ── \[0..1\] CashCount** \- Forward: A Shift selects at most 0..1 CashCount as its official closing count report. \- Reverse: A CashCount is selected as the official closing count for at most 0..1 Shift. **• Shift — CashTransaction: Shift \[1\] ── \[0..\*\] CashTransaction** \- Forward: A Shift records 0..\* physical CashTransactions into or out of its cash drawer. \- Reverse: A CashTransaction occurs within exactly 1 work Shift. |
| 33 | CashCount | A physical count audit of the cash drawer at a point in time, summing total actual physical cash. | Belongs to one Shift and has one or more CashCountDetails. May be selected as that shift’s closing count. | *(Relationships with Shift are defined under \[32\] Shift)* **• CashCount — CashCountDetail: CashCount \[1\] ── \[1..\*\] CashCountDetail** \- Forward: A CashCount contains 1..\* denomination breakdown lines (CashCountDetails). \- Reverse: A CashCountDetail belongs to exactly 1 CashCount. |
| 34 | CashCountDetail | One denomination breakdown line recording the quantity of currency notes or coins and their subtotal. | Belongs to one CashCount. Its amount is the denomination multiplied by the quantity. | *(All relationships have been fully defined in prior entities: \[33\] CashCount \[1\] ── \[1..\*\] CashCountDetail. No outgoing associations to subsequent entities)* |
| 35 | CashTransaction | One cash flow entry or exit in the shift drawer (customer payment, deposit receipt, refund payout, drawer float). | Belongs to one Shift. May link to one Payment, RefundPayment or DepositTransaction; each source has at most one matching cash entry. | *(All relationships have been fully defined in prior entities: \[16\] Payment, \[21\] RefundPayment, \[26\] DepositTransaction, and \[32\] Shift. No outgoing associations to subsequent entities)* |

### *III.3.1 Account*

| Field | Value |

| Purpose | Represents a user who accesses CourtChain with one assigned role. |

| Business identity | Each account has a unique email. It may place bookings and may be assigned to a facility as its workplace. |
| Status / lifecycle | 1\. Start \-\> PendingVerification \[not verified\] \-\> Active (verify email \[valid verification\]) \-\> Inactive (deactivate) 2\. Start \-\> PendingVerification \[not verified\] \-\> Active (verify email \[valid verification\]) \-\> Locked (lock account) \-\> Inactive (deactivate) 3\. Start \-\> PendingVerification \[not verified\] \-\> Active (verify email \[valid verification\]) \-\> Terminated 4\. Start \-\> Active \[already verified\] \-\> Inactive (deactivate) 5\. Start \-\> Active \[already verified\] \-\> Locked (lock account) \-\> Inactive (deactivate) 6\. Start \-\> Active \[already verified\] \-\> Terminated |

| :---- | :---- |
| Purpose | Records maintenance that blocks one or more courts during a specific period. |

| Status / lifecycle | 1\. Start \-\> Scheduled \[starts later\] \-\> InProgress (at(startAt)) \-\> Completed (finish maintenance) 2\. Start \-\> InProgress \[starts now\] \-\> Completed (finish maintenance) |

Start \-\> PendingPayment \-\> Confirmed (confirm payment\[paid, hold valid\] consume held voucher) \-\> Completed (close booking \[all rights resolved, not all cancelled\]) 3\. Start \-\> PendingPayment \-\> Confirmed (confirm payment\[paid, hold valid\] consume held voucher) \-\> Cancelled (close booking\[all rights cancelled\]) |

![][image286]

| Field | Value |
